name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Lower_compileWord_iff
typeText:
∀ (d : Nat) (rels : List.{0} (List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} (Fin d))))
  (w : List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} (Fin d))),
  Iff (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Lower (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.compileWord d rels w))
    (DisequalityDispersion.HardThreshold d rels w)

source.code:
/-- The common encoded hardness statement. -/
theorem Lower_compileWord_iff : (compileWord d rels w).Lower ↔ HardThreshold d rels w := by
  unfold Instance.Lower HardThreshold
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, n, hn, h⟩
    rw [compileWord_dispersion] at h
    exact ⟨n, hn, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, h⟩
    refine ⟨compileWord_valid d rels w, n, hn, ?_⟩
    rw [compileWord_dispersion]
    exact h
